Win two rounds, or lead after three rounds, to take the match. Hit the other robot until its battery runs out. When time runs out, the healthier bot wins the round. Equal batteries draw.

Against the computer, arrow keys also control player one. Local two-player mode shares one keyboard or the two touch-control decks. Some keyboards limit simultaneous keys; use the touch buttons if a key doesn’t register.

Hold movement and an attack together. Blocking drains your shield and reduces damage; release it to recharge. Each robot has a different power blast. Power refills, and landing hits gives you a boost.
